# SMPG (Send Money Payment Gateway)

> Open-source, self-hosted, single-owner, multi-store payment gateway on Cloudflare Workers + D1 enabling Bangladeshi merchants to accept bKash Send Money, Nagad Send Money, and Cash on Delivery (COD) with embedded custom checkout UIs and zero transaction fees.

## Core Concepts
- **Self-Hosted & Single-Owner**: Each user deploys their own Worker + D1 (`bun run setup`) and locks their own Telegram bot via `OWNER_TELEGRAM_ID` or a one-time `/start <SETUP_TOKEN>` link. One bot manages multiple stores and shared/scoped SIM wallets.
- **Embedded Custom Checkout**: Storefronts render their own checkout UI using `SMPG` (server) and `SMPGCheckout` (browser-safe `/c/:id/*` endpoints). There is no separate hosted checkout worker.
- **Asynchronous Verification**: Customers send money from personal mobile banking apps and submit the Transaction ID (TrxID). The owner verifies the TrxID in their Telegram bot and taps Approve or Reject.
- **Undo Grace Period**: Decisions have a 90-second undo window. Payments transition to `PAID` or `REJECTED` and fire webhooks only after 90 seconds.
- **Never Trust Client Submissions**: Submitting a TrxID only moves the payment to `SUBMITTED`. The storefront MUST NOT mark orders as `PAID` until the signed `payment.paid` webhook arrives (`x-smpg-signature`).

## State Machine
```
[CREATED] ──(select COD)────────────> [CONFIRMED]
    │
 (submit TrxID)
    ▼
[SUBMITTED] ──(approve + 90s)───────> [PAID] (terminal)
    │
 (reject + 90s)
    ▼
[REJECTED] ──(resubmit TrxID, max 3)─> [SUBMITTED]
    │
 (/reopen within 7d)
    ▼
[SUBMITTED] (emits payment.reopened)
```

## Quick Installation
```bash
npm install send-money-payment-gateway
# or
bun add send-money-payment-gateway
```

## Server SDK Usage
```typescript
import { SMPG } from 'send-money-payment-gateway';

const smpg = new SMPG(process.env.SMPG_SECRET_KEY!, {
  baseUrl: process.env.SMPG_CORE_URL!, // Your self-hosted Worker URL
  webhookSecret: process.env.SMPG_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
});

// 1. Create Payment Session (success_url and cancel_url are optional)
const payment = await smpg.payments.create(
  {
    amount: 1500,
    external_order_id: 'ORD-1042',
  },
  { idempotencyKey: 'ORD-1042' }
);

// 2. Headless Checkout: Select method & submit TrxID from server
const withMethod = await smpg.payments.selectMethod(payment.id, 'bkash');
console.log('Send money to:', withMethod.assigned_wallet?.number);

await smpg.payments.submit(payment.id, { trx_id: '9K3L2M1ABC' });
```

## Browser-Safe Checkout (No Secret Key)
```typescript
import { SMPGCheckout } from 'send-money-payment-gateway';

// baseUrl is required (accepts string or { baseUrl })
const checkout = new SMPGCheckout({
  baseUrl: 'https://smpg-core.<subdomain>.workers.dev',
});

const session = await checkout.getSession('pay_xxx');
const { assigned_wallet } = await checkout.selectMethod('pay_xxx', 'bkash');
await checkout.submit('pay_xxx', { trx_id: '9K3L2M1ABC' });
```

## Webhook Signature Verification
```typescript
// Important: verify against RAW request body string using `x-smpg-signature`
const signatureHeader = req.headers['x-smpg-signature'];
const rawBody = await req.text(); // or raw Buffer

const event = await smpg.webhooks.constructEvent(rawBody, signatureHeader);

switch (event.type) {
  case 'payment.paid':
    await markOrderPaid(event.data.external_order_id);
    break;
  case 'payment.confirmed':
    await markOrderConfirmed(event.data.external_order_id);
    break;
  case 'payment.rejected':
    await notifyCustomerRetry(event.data.external_order_id);
    break;
  case 'payment.reopened':
    await markOrderAwaitingVerification(event.data.external_order_id);
    break;
}
```
